chunks.sanskrit: abhaṃ̍sya pā̠re bhuva̍nasya̠ maddhye̠ nāka̍sya pṛ̠ṣṭhe ma̍ha̠to mahī̍yān|
śu̠kreṇa̠ jyotī̍gͫṣi samanu̠pravi̍ṣṭaḥ pra̠jāpa̍tiścarati̠ garbhe̍ a̠ntaḥ||
yasmi̍nni̠dagͫ sañca̠ vicaiti̠ sarva̠ym̐yasmi̍n de̠vā adhi̠ viśve̍ niṣe̠duḥ|
tade̠va bhū̠taṃ tadu̠ bhavya̍mā i̠daṃ tada̠khṣare̍ para̠me vyo̍mann||
yenā̍ vṛ̠taṃ khañca̠ divaṃ̍ ma̠hīñca̠ yenā̍di̠tyastapa̍ti̠ teja̍sā̠ bhrāja̍sā ca|
yama̠ntaḥ sa̍mu̠dre ka̠vayo̠ vaya̍nti̠ yada̠khṣare̍ para̠me pra̠jāḥ||
yataḥ̍ prasū̠tā ja̠gataḥ̍ prasūtī̠ toye̍na jī̠vān vyaca̍sarja̠ (vyasa̍sarja̠) bhūmyā̎m|
yadoṣa̍dhībhiḥ pu̠ruṣā̎n pa̠śūgͫͫśca̠ vive̍śa bhū̠tāni̍ carāca̠rāṇi̍||
ataḥ̍ paraṃ̠ nānya̠daṇī̍yasahi̠ parā̎t para̠ym̐yan maha̍to ma̠hānta̎m|
yade̍kama̠vyakta̠mana̍ntarūpa̠vm̐viśvaṃ̍ purā̠ṇaṃ tama̍saḥ̠ para̍stāt tade̠varttaṃ tadu̍ sa̠tyamā̍hu̠stade̠va brahma̍ para̠maṃ ka̍vī̠nām|
i̠ṣṭā̠pū̠rttaṃ ba̍hu̠dhā jā̠taṃ jāya̍mānavm̐vi̠śvaṃ bi̍bhartti̠ bhuva̍nasya̠ nābhiḥ̍||
tade̠va śu̠krama̠mṛtaṃ̠ tadbrahma̠ tadāpaḥ̠ sa pra̠jāpa̍tiḥ||
sa āpaḥ̍ pradu̠ghe u̠bhe i̠me a̠ntari̍khṣa̠matho̠ suvaḥ̍||
naina̍mū̠drdhvaṃ na ti̠ryaṃ ca̠ na maddhye̠ pari̍jagrabhat|
na tasye̍śe̠ kaśca̠na tasya̍ nāma ma̠hadyaśaḥ̍ na sa̠dṛṃśe̍ tiṣṭhati̠ rūpa̍masya̠ na cakhṣu̍ṣā paśyati̠ kaśca̠naina̎m|
hṛ̠dā ma̍nī̠ṣā mana̍sā̠'bhi klṛ̍pto̠ ya e̍navm̐vi̠duramṛ̍tā̠ste bha̍vanti||
vistāraḥ — a̠dbhyaḥ saṃbhū̍taḥ (tai.ā.·3·.·13·.·1·) a̠dbhyaḥ saṃbhū̍taḥ pṛthi̠vyai rasā̎cca|
vistāraḥ — hiraṇyaga̠rbhaḥ (tai.saṃ.·4·.·1·.·8·.·3·) hi̠ra̠ṇya̠ga̠rbhaḥ sama̍vartta̠tāgre̍ bhū̠tasya̍ jā̠taḥ pati̠reka̍ āsīt|
sa dā̍dhāra pṛthi̠vīṃ dyāmu̠temāṃ kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
yaḥ prā̍ṇa̠to ni̍miṣa̠to ma̍hi̠tvaika̠ idrājā̠ jaga̍to ba̠bhūva̍|
ya īśe̍ a̠sya dvi̠pada̠ścatu̍ṣpa̠daḥ kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
ya ā̎tma̠dā ba̍la̠dā yasya̠ viśva̍ upā̠sa̍te pra̠śiṣa̠ym̐yasya̍ de̠vāḥ|
yasya̍ chā̠yāmṛta̠ym̐yasya̍ mṛ̠tyuḥ kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
yasye̠me hi̠mava̍nto mahi̠tvā yasya̍ samu̠dragͫ ra̠sayā̍ sa̠hā''huḥ|
yasye̠māḥ pra̠diśo̠ yasya̍ bā̠hū kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
yaṃ kranda̍sī̠ ava̍sā tastabhā̠ne a̠bhyaikhṣe̍tāṃ̠ mana̍sā̠ reja̍māne|
yatrādhi̠sūra̠ udi̍tau̠ vyeti̠ kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
yena̠ dyauru̠grā pṛ̍thi̠vī ca̍ dṛ̠ḍhe yena̠ suva̍s stabhi̠taym̐yena̠ nākaḥ̍|
yo a̠ntari̍khṣe̠ raja̍so vi̠mānaḥ̠ kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
tato̍ de̠vānā̠nnira̍vartta̠tāsu̠rekaḥ̠ kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
yo de̠veṣvadhi̍ de̠va yeka̠ āsī̠t kasmai̍ de̠vāya̍ ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema||
e̠ṣa hi de̠vaḥ pra̠diśo'nu̠ sarvāḥ̠ pūrvo̍ hi jā̠taḥ sa u̠ garbhe̍ a̠ntaḥ|
sa vi̠jāya̍mānaḥ sajani̠ṣyamā̍ṇaḥ pra̠tyaṅmukhā̎ stiṣṭhati vi̠śvato̍mukhaḥ||
vi̠śvata̍ścakhṣuru̠ta vi̠śvato̍ mukho vi̠śvato̍ hasta u̠ta vi̠śvata̍spāt|
saṃ bā̠hubhyāṃ̠ nama̍ti̠ saṃ pata̍trai̠rdyāvā̍ pṛthi̠vī ja̠naya̍n de̠va ekaḥ̍||
ve̠nastat paśya̠nviśvā̠ bhuva̍nāni vi̠dvānyatra̠ viśvaṃ̠ bhava̠tyeka̍nīḷam|
yasmi̍nni̠dagͫ sañca̠ vicaika̠g̠ͫ sa otaḥ̠ prota̍śca vi̠bhuḥ pra̠jāsu̍||
pratadvo̍ce a̠mṛta̠nnu vi̠dvān ga̍ndha̠rvo nāma̠ nihi̍taṃ̠ guhā̍su trīṇi̍ pa̠dā nihi̍tā̠ guhā̍su̠ yastadveda̍ savi̠tuḥ pi̠tā'sa̍t||
sa no̠ bandhu̍rjani̠tā sa vi̍dhā̠tā dhāmā̍ni̠ veda̠ bhuva̍nāni̠ viśvā̎|
pari̠ dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vī ya̍nti sa̠dyaḥ pari̍ lo̠kān pari̠ diśaḥ̠ pari̠ suvaḥ̍|
pa̠rītya̍ lo̠kān pa̠rītya̍ bhū̠tāni̍ pa̠rītya̠ sarvāḥ̎ pra̠diśo̠ diśa̍śca|
uddī̎pyasva jātavedo 'pa̠ghnanniṛ̍rtiṃ̠ mama̍ pa̠śūgͫͫśca̠ mahya̠māva̍ha̠ jīva̍nañca̠ diśo̍ diśa||
māno̍ higͫsī jjātavedo̠ gāmaśvaṃ̠ puru̍ṣaṃ̠ jaga̍t|
tatpuru̍ṣāya vi̠dmahe̍ cakratu̠ṇḍāya̍ dhīmahi tanno̍ nandiḥ praco̠dayā̎t||
va̠jra̠na̠khāya̍ vi̠dmahe̍ tīkhṣṇada̠g̠ͫͫṣṭrāya̍ dhīmahi tanno̍ nārasigͫhaḥ praco̠dayā̎t||
sarva̍gͫ haratu̍ me pā̠paṃ̠ dū̠rvā duḥ̍svapna̠ nāśa̍nī||
kāṇḍā̎t kāṇḍāt pra̠roha̍ntī̠ paru̍ṣaḥ paruṣaḥ̠ pari̍ e̠vā no̍ dūrve̠ prata̍nu sa̠hasre̍ṇa śa̠tena̍ ca||
śirasā̍ dhāra̍yiṣyā̠mi̠ ra̠khṣa̠sva māṃ̎ pade̠ pade||
mṛ̠ttike̍ hana̍ me pā̠pa̠ym̐ya̠nma̠yā du̍ṣkṛtaṃ̠ kṛtam|
mṛ̠ttike̍ dehi̍ me pu̠ṣṭiṃ̠ tva̠yi sa̍rvaṃ pra̠tiṣṭhi̍tam mṛ̠ttike̎ pratiṣṭhi̍te sa̠rvaṃ̠ ta̠nme ni̍rṇuda̠ mṛtti̍ke|
tayā̍ ha̠tena̍ pāpe̠na̠ ga̠cchā̠mi pa̍ramāṃ̠ gatim||
yata̍ indra̠ bhayā̍mahe̠ tato̍ no̠ abha̍yaṃ kṛdhi|
magha̍van cha̠gdhi tava̠ tanna̍ ū̠taye̠ vidviṣo̠ vimṛdho̍ jahi||
vṛṣendraḥ̍ pu̠ra e̍tu naḥ svasti̠dā a̍bhayaṅka̠raḥ||
sva̠sti na̠ indro̍ vṛ̠ddhaśra̍vāḥ sva̠sti naḥ̍ pū̠ṣā vi̠śvave̍dāḥ|
sva̠sti na̠stārkhṣyo̠ ari̍ṣṭanemiḥ sva̠sti no̠ bṛha̠spati̍r dadhātu||
somo̠ viśvā̎nyata̠sā vanā̍ni̠ nārvāgindraṃ̍ prati̠mānā̍ni debhuḥ brahma̍ jajñā̠naṃ pra̍tha̠maṃ pu̠rastā̠dvisī̍ma̠taḥ su̠ruco̍ ve̠na ā̍vaḥ|
sa bu̠dhniyā̍ upa̠mā a̍sya vi̠ṣṭhāḥ sa̠taśca̠ yoni̠masa̍taśca̠ vivaḥ̍||
ma̠hāgͫ indro̠ vajra̍bāhuḥ ṣoḍa̠śī śarma̍ yacchatu sva̠sti no̍ ma̠ghavā̍ karotu̠ hantu̍ pā̠pmāna̠ym̐yo̎'smān dveṣṭi̍||
śarī̍raym̐yajñaśama̠laṃ kusī̍daṃ̠ tasmi̎n thsīdatu̠ yo̎'smān dveṣṭi̍||
tena̍ pa̠vitre̍ṇa śu̠ddhena̍ pū̠tā ati̍ pā̠pmāna̠marā̍tiṃ tarema||
sa̠joṣā̍ indra̠ saga̍ṇo ma̠rudbhiḥ̠ somaṃ̍ piba vṛtrahañchūra vi̠dvān|
ja̠hi śatrū̠g̠ͫ rapa̠ mṛdho̍ nuda̠svāthābha̍yaṃ kṛṇuhi vi̠śvato̍ naḥ||
su̠mi̠trā na̠ āpa̠ oṣa̍dhayaḥ santu durmi̠trāstasmai̍ bhūyāsu̠r yā̎'smān dveṣṭi̠ yañca̍ va̠yaṃ dvi̠ṣmaḥ||
āpo̠ hiṣṭhā ma̍yo̠ bhuva̠stā na̍ ū̠rje da̍dhātana ma̠heraṇā̍ya̠ cakhṣa̍se|
yo vaḥ̍ śi̠vata̍mo̠ rasa̠stasya̍ bhājayate̠ ha naḥ̍|
hira̍ṇyaśṛṅga̠vm̐varu̍ṇaṃ̠ prapa̍dye tī̠rthaṃ me̍ dehi̠ yāci̍taḥ|
yanme̠ mana̍sā vā̠cā̠ ka̠rma̠ṇā vā du̍ṣkṛtaṃ̠ kṛtam|
tanna̠ indro̠ varu̍ṇo̠ bṛha̠spatiḥ̍ savi̠tā ca̍ punantu̠ punaḥ̍ punaḥ||
namo̠'gnaye̎'phsu̠mate̠ nama̠ indrā̍ya̠ namo̠ varu̍ṇāya̠ namo vāruṇyai̍ namo̠'dbhyaḥ yada̠pāṃ krū̠raym̐yada̍me̠ddhyaym̐yada̍śā̠ntaṃ tadapa̍gacchatāt||
i̠maṃ me̍ gaṃge yamune sarasvati̠ śutu̍dri̠ stoma̍gͫ sacatā̠ paru̠ṣṇiyā|
tato̠ rātri̍rajāyata̠ tataḥ̍ samu̠dro a̍rṇa̠vaḥ sa̠mu̠drāda̍rṇa̠vādadhi̍ savm̐vathsa̠ro a̍jāyata|
dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vyorhi̍ra̠ṇmaya̠g̠ͫ sagͫͫśri̍ta̠g̠ͫ suvaḥ̍ sa naḥ̠ suvaḥ̠ sagͫ śi̍śādhi||
ākrā̎nthsamu̠draḥ pra̍tha̠me vidha̍rmañja̠naya̍n pra̠jā bhuva̍nasya̠ rājā̎|
vṛṣā̍ pa̠vitre̠ adhi̠sāno̠ avye̍ bṛ̠hath somo̍ vāvṛdhe suvā̠na induḥ̍
sa naḥ̍ parṣa̠dati̍ du̠rgāṇi̠ viśvā̍ nā̠veva̠ sindhuṃ̍ duri̠tā'tya̠gniḥ||
du̠rgāṃ de̠vīgͫ śara̍ṇama̠haṃ prapa̍dye su̠tara̍si tarase̠ namaḥ̍||
agne̠ tvaṃ pā̍rayā̠ navyo̍ a̠smānth sva̠stibhi̠rati̍ du̠rgāṇi̠ viśvā̎|
pūśca̍ pṛ̠thvī ba̍hu̠lā na̍ u̠rvī bhavā̍ to̠kāya̠ tana̍yāya̠ śaym̐yoḥ||
viśvā̍ni no du̠rgahā̍ jātavedaḥ̠ sindhuṃ̠ na nā̠vā du̍ri̠tā'ti̍parṣi|
agne̍ atri̠van mana̍sā gṛṇā̠no̎'smākaṃ̍ boddhyavi̠tā ta̠nūnā̎m||
sa naḥ̍ parṣa̠dati̍ du̠rgāṇi̠ viśvā̠ khṣāma̍dde̠vo ati̍ duri̠tā'tya̠gniḥ||
pra̠tnoṣi̍ka̠mīḍyo̍ addhva̠reṣu̍ sa̠nācca̠ hotā̠ navya̍śca̠ sathsi̍|
nāka̍sya pṛ̠ṣṭhama̠bhi sa̠vm̐vasā̍no̠ vaiṣṇa̍vīlm̐lo̠ka i̠ha mā̍dayantām

bhūranna̍ma̠gnaye̍ pṛthi̠vyai svāhā̠ , bhuvo'nna̍vm̐vā̠yave̠'ntari̍khṣāya̠ svāhā̠, suva̠ranna̍mādi̠tyāya̍ di̠ve svāhā̠ , bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠rannaṃ̍ ca̠ndrama̍se di̠gbhyaḥ svāhā̠ , namo̍ de̠vebhyaḥ̍ sva̠dhā pi̠tṛbhyo̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠ranna̠moṃ

bhūra̠gnaye̍ pṛthi̠vyai svāhā̠, bhuvo̍ vā̠yave̠'ntari̍khṣāya̠ svāhā̠ , suva̍rādi̠tyāya̍ di̠ve svāhā̠ , bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̍śca̠ndrama̍se di̠gbhyaḥ svāhā̠, namo̍ de̠vebhyaḥ̍ sva̠dhā pi̠tṛbhyo̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠ragna̠ oṃ

bhūra̠gnaye̍ ca pṛthi̠vyai ca̍ maha̠te ca̠ svāhā̠ , bhuvo̍ vā̠yave̍ cā̠ntari̍khṣāya ca maha̠te ca̠ svāhā̠ , suva̍rādi̠tyāya̍ ca di̠ve ca̍ maha̠te ca̠ svāhā̠ , bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̍śca̠ndrama̍se ca̠ nakhṣa̍trebhyaśca di̠gbhyaśca̍ maha̠te ca̠ svāhā̠, namo̍ de̠vebhyaḥ̍ sva̠dhā pi̠tṛbhyo̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠r maha̠roṃ
sacāgͫ śikyaḥ puro vāco̍pani̠ṣadindro̎ jye̠ṣṭha i̍ndri̠yāya̠ ṛṣi̍bhyo̠ namo̍ de̠vebhyaḥ̍ sva̠dhā pi̠tṛbhyo̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠ śchanda̠ oṃ
namo̠ brahma̍ṇe dhā̠raṇaṃ̍ me a̠stvani̍rākaraṇaṃdhā̠rayi̍tā bhūyāsaṃ̠ karṇa̍yoḥ śru̠taṃ mācyo̎ḍhvaṃ̠ mamā̠muṣya̠ oṃ
ṛ̠taṃ tapaḥ̍ sa̠tyaṃ tapaḥ̍ śru̠taṃ tapaḥ̍ śā̠ntaṃ tapo̠ dama̠ stapaḥ̠ śama̠stapo̠ dānaṃ̠ tapo̠ yajñaṃ̠ tapo̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠rbrahmai̠tadupā̎syai̠tattapaḥ̍

yathā̍ vṛ̠khṣasya̍ sa̠puṃṣpi̍tasya dū̠rād ga̠ndho vā̎tye̠vaṃ puṇya̍sya ka̠rmaṇo̍ dū̠rād ga̠ndho vā̍ti̠ yathā̍'sidhā̠rāṃ ka̠rtte'va̍hitāmava̠krāme̠ yadyuve̠ yuve̠ havā̍ vi̠hvayi̍ṣyāmi ka̠rttaṃ pa̍tiṣyā̠mītye̠vama̠mṛtā̍dā̠tmānaṃ̍ ju̠guphse̎t
a̠ṇoraṇī̍yān maha̠to mahī̍yānā̠tmā guhā̍yāṃ̠ nihi̍to'sya ja̠ntoḥ|
sa̠pta prā̠ṇāḥ pra̠bhava̍nti̠ tasmā̎th sa̠ptārciṣaḥ̍ sa̠midhaḥ̍ sa̠pta ji̠hvāḥ|
sa̠pta i̠me lo̠kā yeṣu̠ cara̍nti prā̠ṇā gu̠hāśa̍yā̠nnihi̍tāḥ sa̠pta sa̍pta||
ataḥ̍ samu̠drā gi̠raya̍śca̠ sarve̠'smāth syanda̍nte̠ sindha̍vaḥ̠ sarva̍rūpāḥ|
ata̍śca̠ viśvā̠ oṣa̍dhayo̠ rasā̎cca̠ yenai̍ṣa bhū̠tasti̍ṣṭhatyantarā̠tmā||
bra̠hmā de̠vānāṃ̎ pada̠vīḥ ka̍vī̠nāmṛṣi̠rviprā̍ṇāṃ mahi̠ṣo mṛ̠gāṇā̎m|
śye̠no gṛdhrā̍ṇā̠g̠ͫͫ svadhi̍ti̠rvanā̍nā̠g̠ͫ somaḥ̍ pa̠vitra̠ matye̍ti̠ rebha̍nn||
a̠jā mekā̠lm̐lohi̍taśuklakṛ̠ṣṇāṃ ba̠hvīṃ pra̠jāṃ ja̠naya̍ntī̠g̠ͫ sarū̍pām|
a̠jo hyeko̍ ju̠ṣamā̍ṇo'nu̠śete̠ jahā̎tyenāṃ bhu̠ktabho̍gā̠majo̎'nyaḥ ha̠g̠ͫsaḥ śu̍ci̠ṣad vasu̍rantarikhṣa̠saddhotā̍ vedi̠ṣadati̍thirduroṇa̠sat|
nṛ̠ṣadva̍ra̠sadṛ̍ta̠sad vyo̍ma̠sada̠bjā go̠jā ṛ̍ta̠jā a̍dri̠jā ṛ̠taṃ bṛ̠hat||
ghṛ̠taṃ mi̍mikhṣire ghṛ̠tama̍sya̠ yoni̍rghṛ̠te śri̠to ghṛ̠tamu̍vasya̠ dhāma̍|
a̠nu̠ṣva̠dhamāva̍ha mā̠daya̍sva̠ svāhā̍ kṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakhṣi ha̠vyam||
ghṛ̠tasya̠ nāma̠ guhya̠ym̐yadasti̍ ji̠hvā de̠vānā̍ma̠mṛta̍sya̠ nābhiḥ̍||
va̠yaṃ nāma̠ prabra̍vāmā ghṛ̠tenā̠sminya̠jñe dhā̍rayāmā̠ namo̍bhiḥ|
upa̍ bra̠hmā śṛ̍ṇavaccha̠syamā̍naṃ̠ catuḥ̍ śṛṅgo 'vamīd gau̠ra e̠tat||
ca̠tvāri̠ śṛṅgā̠ trayo̍ asya̠ pādā̠ dve śī̠ra̠ṣe sa̠pta hastā̍so a̠sya|
tridhā̍ ba̠ddho vṛ̍ṣa̠bho ro̍ravīti ma̠ho de̠vo martyā̠g̠ͫ āvi̍veśa tridhā̍ hi̠taṃ pa̠ṇibhi̍r gu̠hyamā̍naṃ̠ gavi̍de̠vāso̍ ghṛ̠tamanva̍vindann|
indra̠ eka̠g̠ͫ sūrya̠ ekaṃ̍ jajāna ve̠nā deka̍gͫͫ sva̠dhayā̠ niṣṭa̍takhṣuḥ||
yo de̠vānāṃ̎ pratha̠maṃ pu̠rastā̠d viśvā̠dhiyo̍ ru̠dro ma̠harṣiḥ̍|
hi̠ra̠ṇya̠ga̠rbhaṃ pa̍śyata̠ jāya̍māna̠g̠ͫ sano̍ de̠vaḥ śu̠bhayā̠ smṛtyā̠ saym̐yu̍naktu||
yasmā̠tparaṃ̠ nāpa̍ra̠ masti̠ kiñci̠dyasmā̠n nāṇī̍yo̠ na jyāyo̎'sti̠ kaści̍t|
vṛ̠khṣa i̍va stabdho di̠vi ti̍ṣṭha̠tyeka̠stene̠daṃ pū̠rṇaṃ puru̍ṣeṇa̠ sarva̎m||
na karma̍ṇā na pra̠jayā̠ dhane̍na̠ tyāge̍naike amṛta̠tvamā̍na̠śuḥ|
pare̍ṇa̠ nākaṃ̠ nihi̍taṃ̠ guhā̍yāvm̐vi̠bhrāja̍de̠tad yata̍yo vi̠śanti̍||
ve̠dā̠nta̠ vi̠jñāna̠suni̍ścitā̠rthāḥ sanyā̍sa yo̠gādyata̍yaḥ śuddha̠ sattvāḥ̎|
te bra̍hmalo̠ke tu̠ parā̎ntakāle̠ parā̍mṛtā̠t pari̍mucyanti̠ sarve̎||
da̠hra̠vm̐vi̠pā̠paṃ pa̠rame̎śma bhūta̠ym̐yat pu̍ṇḍarī̠kaṃ pu̠rama̍ddhya sa̠g̠ͫͫstham|
yo vedādau sva̍raḥ pro̠kto̠ ve̠dānte̍ ca pra̠tiṣṭhi̍taḥ|
tasya̍ pra̠kṛti̍līna̠sya̠ yaḥ̠ paraḥ̍ sa ma̠heśva̍raḥ
nā̠rāya̠ṇa pa̍raṃ bra̠hma̠ ta̠ttvaṃ nā̍rāya̠ṇaḥ pa̍raḥ|
nā̠rāya̠ṇa pa̍ro dhyā̠tā̠ dhyā̠naṃ nā̍rāya̠ṇaḥ pa̍raḥ||
yacca̍ ki̠ñcijja̍gath sa̠rvaṃ̠ dṛ̠śyate̎ śrūya̠te'pi̍ vā anta̍r ba̠hiśca̍ tath sa̠rva̠vm̐vyā̠pya nā̍rāya̠ṇaḥ sthi̍taḥ||
tasyānte̍ suṣi̠ragͫ sū̠khṣmaṃ tasmi̎nth sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitam||
tasya̠ maddhye̍ ma̠hāna̍gnir vi̠śvārci̍r vi̠śvato̍ mukhaḥ|
sa brahma̠ sa śivaḥ̠ sa hariḥ̠ sendraḥ̠ so'khṣa̍raḥ para̠maḥ sva̠rāṭ

ā̠di̠tyo vā e̠ṣa e̠tan ma̠ṇḍalaṃ̠ tapa̍ti̠ tatra̠ tā ṛca̠stadṛ̠cā ma̍ṇḍala̠g̠ͫ sa ṛ̠cālm̐lo̠ko'tha̠ya e̠ṣa e̠tasmi̍n ma̠ṇḍale̠'rcir dī̠pyate̠ tāni̠ sāmā̍ni̠ sa sā̠mnālm̐lo̠ko'tha̠ ya e̠ṣa e̠tasmi̍n ma̠ṇḍale̠'rciṣi̠ puru̍ṣa̠stāni̠ yajū̍gͫṣi̠ sa yaju̍ṣā maṇḍala̠g̠ͫ sa yaju̍ṣālm̐lo̠kaḥ saiṣā tra̠yyeva̍ vi̠dyā ta̍pati̠ ya e̠ṣo̎'ntarā̍di̠tye hi̍ra̠ṇmayaḥ̠ puru̍ṣaḥ

ā̠di̠tyo vai teja̠ ojo̠ bala̠ym̐yaśa̠ścakhṣuḥ̠ śrotra̍mā̠tmā mano̍ ma̠nyurmanu̍rmṛ̠tyuḥ sa̠tyo mi̠tro vā̠yurā̍kā̠śaḥ prā̠ṇo lo̍kapā̠laḥ kaḥ kiṃ kaṃ tath sa̠tyamanna̍ma̠mṛtā̍ jī̠vo viśvaḥ̍ kata̠maḥ sva̍ya̠bhuṃ brahmai̠ tadamṛ̍ta e̠ṣa puru̍ṣa e̠ṣa bhū̠tānā̠madhi̍pati̠rbrahma̍ṇaḥ̠ sāyu̍jyagͫ salo̠katā̍māpnotye̠tāsā̍me̠va de̠vatā̍nā̠g̠ͫ sāyu̍jyagͫ sā̠rṣṭitā̍gͫ samāna lo̠katā̍māpnoti̠ ya e̠vavm̐vede̎tyupa̠niṣat
etathsomasya̍ sūrya̠sya̠ sarvaliṅga̍gͫͫ sthāpa̠ya̠ti̠ pāṇimantraṃ̍ pavi̠tram
sa̠dyojā̠taṃ pra̍padyā̠mi̠ sa̠dyojā̠tāya̠ vai namo̠ namaḥ̍|

vā̠ma̠de̠vāya̠ namo̎ jye̠ṣṭhāya̠ namaḥ̍ śre̠ṣṭhāya̠ namo̍ ru̠drāya̠ namaḥ̠ kālā̍ya̠ namaḥ̠ kala̍vikaraṇāya̠ namo̠ bala̍vikaraṇāya̠ namo̠ balā̍ya̠ namo̠ bala̍pramathanāya̠ namaḥ̠ sarva̍bhūtadamanāya̠ namo̍ ma̠nonma̍nāya̠ namaḥ̍
sarve̎bhyaḥ sarva̠ śarve̎bhyo̠ nama̍ste astu ru̠drarū̍pebhyaḥ
īśānaḥ sarva̍vidyā̠nā̠ mīśvaraḥ sarva̍bhūtā̠nāṃ̠ brahmādhi̍pati̠r brahma̠ṇo'dhi̍pati̠r brahmā̍ śi̠vo me̍ astu sadāśi̠voṃ
namo hiraṇyabāhave hiraṇyavarṇāya hiraṇyarūpāya hiraṇyapataye 'biṃkāpataya umāpataye paśupataye̍ namo̠ namaḥ
ṛ̠tagͫ sa̠tyaṃ pa̍raṃ bra̠hma̠ pu̠ruṣaṃ̍ kṛṣṇa̠piṅga̍lam|
sarvo̠ vai ru̠drastasmai̍ ru̠drāya̠ namo̍ astu|
puru̍ṣo̠ vai ru̠draḥ sanma̠ho namo̠ namaḥ̍|
viśvaṃ̍ bhū̠taṃ bhuva̍naṃ ci̠traṃ ba̍hu̠dhā jā̠taṃ jāya̍mānaṃ ca̠ yat|
sarvo̠ hye̍ṣa ru̠drastasmai̍ ru̠drāya̠ namo̍ astu
yasya̠ vai ka̍ṅkatyagnihotra̠hava̍ṇī bhavati̠ pratye̠vāsyāhu̍taya stiṣṭha̠ntyatho̠ prati̍ṣṭhityai
(tai.saṃ.·1·.·2·.·14·.·1·) kṛ̠ṇu̠ṣva pājaḥ̠ prasi̍ti̠nna pṛ̠thvīym̐yā̠hi rāje̠ vāma̍vā̠g̠ͫ ibhe̍na|
tṛ̠ṣvīmanu̠ prasi̍tiṃ drūṇā̠no'stā̍'si̠ viddhya̍ ra̠khṣa sa̠stapi̍ṣṭhaiḥ||
1 tava̍ bhra̠māsa̍ āśu̠yā pa̍ta̠ntyanu̍ spṛśa dhṛṣa̠tā śośu̍cānaḥ|
tapū̍gͫͫṣyagne ju̠hvā̍ pata̠gāṃna sa̍ndito̠ visṛ̍ja̠ viṣva̍ gu̠lkāḥ||
2 prati̠spaśo̠ visṛ̍ja̠ tūrṇi̍ tamo̠ bhavā̍ pā̠yur vi̠śo a̠syā ada̍bdhaḥ|
yo no̍ dū̠re a̠ghaśa̍gͫso̠ yo antya̍gne̠ māki̍ṣṭe̠ vyathi̠rā da̍dharṣīt||
3 uda̍gne tiṣṭha̠ pratyā ta̍nuṣva̠nya̍ mitrā̍gͫ oṣatāt tigmahete|
yo no̠ arā̍tigͫ samidhāna ca̠kre nī̠cātaṃ dha̍khṣyata̠ sanna śuṣka̎m||
ava̍sthi̠rā ta̍nuhi yātu̠ jūnāṃ̎ jā̠mimajā̍miṃ̠ pramṛ̍ṇīhi̠ śatrū̍n||

adi̍tirde̠vā ga̍ndha̠rvā ma̍nu̠ṣyāḥ̎ pi̠taro'su̍rā̠steṣā̍gͫ sarva bhū̠tānāṃ̎ mā̠tā me̠dinī̍ maha̠tā ma̠hī sā̍vi̠trī gā̍ya̠trī jaga̍tyu̠rvī pṛ̠thvī ba̍hu̠lā viśvā̍ bhū̠tā ka̍ta̠mā kāyā sā sa̠tyetya̠mṛteti̍ vasi̠ṣṭhaḥ

āpo̠ vā i̠dagͫ sarva̠vm̐viśvā̍ bhū̠tānyāpaḥ̍ prā̠ṇā vā āpaḥ̍ pa̠śava̠ āpo'nna̠māpo 'mṛ̍ta̠māpaḥ̍ sa̠mrāḍāpo̍ vi̠rāḍāpaḥ̍ sva̠rāḍāpaḥ̠ chandā̠g̠ͫͫsyāpo̠ jyotī̠g̠ͫͫṣyāpo̠ yajū̠g̠ͫͫṣyāpaḥ̍ sa̠tyamāpaḥ̠ sarvā̍ de̠vatā̠ āpo̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠rāpa̠ oṃ
āpaḥ̍ punantu pṛthi̠vīṃ pṛ̍thi̠vī pū̠tā pu̍nātu̠ mām|
pu̠nantu̠ brahma̍ṇa̠spati̠r brahma̍ pū̠tā pu̍nātu̠ mām||
āyā̍tu̠ vara̍dā de̠vī̠ a̠khṣaraṃ̍ brahma̠ saṃmi̍tam|
gā̠ya̠trīṃ̎ chanda̍sāṃ mā̠tedaṃ bra̍hma ju̠ṣasva̍ me|
yad rātriyā̎t kuru̍te pā̠paṃ̠ tad rātriyā̎t prati̠mucya̍te|
sarva̍ va̠rṇe ma̍hāde̠vi̠ sa̠ndhyā vi̍dye sa̠rasva̍ti

ojo̍'si̠ saho̍'si̠ bala̍masi̠ bhrājo̍'si de̠vānāṃ̠ dhāma̠nāmā̍'si̠ viśva̍masi vi̠śvāyuḥ̠ sarva̍masi sa̠rvāyurabhibhūroṃgāyatrīmāvā̍hayā̠mi̠ sāvitrīmāvā̍hayā̠mi̠ sarasvatīmāvā̍hayā̠mi̠ chandarṣīnāvā̍hayā̠mi̠ śriyamāvā̍hayā̠mi̠ gāyatriyā gāyatrī chando viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ savitā devatā'gnirmukhaṃ brahmā śiro viṣṇurhṛdayagͫ rudraḥ śikhā pṛthivīyoniḥ prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānā saprāṇā śvetavarṇā sāṅkhyāyanasagotrā gāyatrī caturvigͫśatyakhṣarā tripadā̍ ṣaṭku̠khṣiḥ̠ pañca śīrṣopanayane vi̍niyo̠ga̠, oṃ bhūḥ|
oṃ tath sa̍vi̠turvare̎ṇyaṃ̠ bhargo̍ de̠vasya̍ dhīmahi|
u̠ttame̍ śikha̍re jā̠te̠ bhū̠myāṃ pa̍rvata̠ mūdrdha̍ni|
stuto mayā varadā ve̍damā̠tā̠ pracodayantī pavane̎ dvijā̠tā|
āyuḥ pṛthivyāṃdraviṇaṃ bra̍hmava̠rca̠saṃ̠ mahyaṃ datvā prajātuṃ bra̍hmalo̠kam
sa̠tyavm̐vai tad rasa̠māpo̠ jyotī̠raso̠'mṛtaṃ̠ brahma̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠roṃ
a̠dyā no̍ deva savitaḥ pra̠jāva̍thsāvīḥ̠ saubha̍gam|
bra̠hmā de̠vānāṃ̎ pada̠vīḥ ka̍vī̠nāmṛṣi̠r viprā̍ṇāṃ mahi̠ṣo mṛ̠gāṇā̎m|
śye̠no gṛddhrā̍ṇā̠g̠ͫͫ svadhi̍ti̠rvanā̍nā̠g̠ͫ somaḥ̍ pa̠vitra̠matye̍ti̠ rebha̍nn||
nṛ̠ṣadva̍ra̠sadṛ̍ta̠sad vyo̍ma̠sada̠bjā go̠jā ṛ̍ta̠jā a̍dri̠jā ṛ̠taṃ bṛ̠hat||
ṛ̠cetvā̍ ru̠cetvā̠ samith sra̍vanti sa̠rito̠ na dhenāḥ̎|
tasmi̎nth supa̠rṇo ma̍dhu̠kṛt ku̍lā̠yī bhaja̍nnāste̠ madhu̍ de̠vatā̎bhyaḥ|
tasyā̍ sate̠ hara̍yaḥ sa̠ptatīre̎ sva̠dhāṃ duhā̍nā a̠mṛta̍sya̠ dhārā̎m|
me̠dhāde̠vī ju̠ṣamā̍ṇā na̠ āgā̎d vi̠śvācī̍ bha̠drā su̍mana̠sya mā̍nā|
tvayā̠ juṣṭā̍ nu̠damā̍nā du̠ruktā̎n bṛ̠hadva̍dema vi̠dathe̍ su̠vīrāḥ̎||
tvayā̠ juṣṭa̍ ṛ̠ṣir bha̍vati devi̠ tvayā̠ brahmā̍''ga̠taśrī̍ ru̠ta tvayā̎|
tvayā̠ juṣṭa̍ści̠travm̐vi̍ndate vasu̠ sā no̍ juṣasva̠ dravi̍ṇo namedhe
me̠dhāṃ ma̠ indro̍ dadātu me̠dhāṃ de̠vī sara̍svatī|
a̠phsa̠rāsu̍ ca̠ yā me̠dhā ga̍ndha̠rveṣu̍ ca̠ yanmanaḥ̍|
daivīṃ̎ me̠dhā sara̍svatī̠ sā māṃ̎ me̠dhā su̠rabhi̍r juṣatā̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎
āmāṃ̎ me̠dhā su̠rabhi̍r vi̠śvarū̍pā̠ hira̍ṇyavarṇā̠ jaga̍tī jaga̠myā|
ūrja̍svatī̠ paya̍sā̠ pinva̍mānā̠ sā māṃ̎ me̠dhā su̠pratī̍kā juṣantām
mayi̍ me̠dhāṃ mayi̍ pra̠jāṃ mayya̠gnistejo̍ dadhātu̠ mayi̍ me̠dhāṃ mayi̍ pra̠jāṃ mayīndra̍ indri̠yaṃ da̍dhātu̠ mayi̍ me̠dhāṃ mayi̍ pra̠jāṃ mayi̠ sūryo̠ bhrājo̍ dadhātu
apai̍tu mṛ̠tyura̠mṛta̍nna̠ āga̍n vaivasva̠to no̠ abha̍yaṅkṛṇotu|
pa̠rṇavm̐vana̠spate̍ rivā̠bhinaḥ̍ śīyatāgͫ ra̠yiḥ saca̍tānnaḥ̠ śacī̠patiḥ̍
paraṃ̍ mṛtyo̠ anu̠ pare̍hi̠ panthā̠ym̐yaste̠sva ita̍ro deva̠yānā̎t|
cakhṣu̍ṣmate śṛṇva̠te te̎ bravīmi̠ mānaḥ̍ pra̠jāgͫ rī̍riṣo̠ mota vī̠rān
vātaṃ̍ prā̠ṇaṃ mana̍sā̠ nvāra̍bhāmahe pra̠jāpa̍ti̠ym̐yo bhuva̍nasya go̠pāḥ|
sano̍ mṛ̠tyo strā̍yatāṃ̠ pātvagͫha̍so̠ jyog jī̠vā ja̠rāma̍śīmahi
a̠mu̠tra̠ bhūyā̠dadha̠ yadya̠masya̠ bṛha̍spate a̠bhiśa̍ste̠ra mu̍ñcaḥ|
pratyau̍hatā ma̠śvinā̍ mṛ̠tyu ma̍smād de̠vānā̍magne bhi̠ṣajā̠ śacī̍bhiḥ
hari̠g̠ͫ hara̍nta̠ manu̍yanti de̠vā viśva̠syeśā̍naṃ vṛṣa̠bhaṃ ma̍tī̠nām|
mā chi̍do mṛtyo̠ mā va̍dhī̠rmā me̠ bala̠vm̐vivṛ̍ho̠ mā pramo̍ṣīḥ|
pra̠jāṃ mā me̍ rīriṣa̠ āyu̍rugra nṛ̠cakhṣa̍saṃ tvā ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema
mā no̍ ma̠hānta̍mu̠ta mā no̍ arbha̠kaṃ mā na̠ ukhṣa̍ntamu̠ta mā na̍ ukhṣi̠tam|
mā no̍ vadhīḥ pi̠taraṃ̠ mota mā̠taraṃ̍ pri̠yā mā na̍sta̠nuvo̍ rudra rīriṣaḥ
mā na̍sto̠ke tana̍ye̠ mā na̠ āyu̍ṣi̠ mā no̠ goṣu̠ mā no̠ aśve̍ṣu rīriṣaḥ|
vī̠rānmā no̍ rudra bhāmi̠tova̍dhīrha̠viṣma̍nto̠ nama̍sā vidhema te
prajā̍pate̠ na tvade̠tānya̠nyo viśvā̍ jā̠tāni̠ pari̠tā ba̍bhūva|
yat kā̍māste juhu̠mastanno̍ astu va̠yagͫͫ syā̍ma̠ pata̍yo rayī̠ṇām
vṛṣendraḥ̍ pu̠ra e̍tu nassvasti̠dā a̍bhayaṃ ka̠raḥ
ye te̍ sa̠hasra̍ma̠yutaṃ̠ pāśā̠ mṛtyo̠ martyā̍ya̠ hanta̍ve|
yaddi̠vā ca̠ naktaṃ̠ caina̍ścakṛ̠ma tasyā̍ va̠yaja̍namasi̠ svāhā̎|
yath sva̠panta̍śca̠ jāgra̍ta̠ścaina̍ścakṛ̠ma tasyā̍ va̠yaja̍namasi̠ svāhā̎|
yath su̠ṣupta̍śca̠ jāgra̍ta̠ścaina̍ścakṛ̠ma tasyā̍ va̠yaja̍namasi̠ svāhā̎|
yad vi̠dvāgͫsa̠ścā vi̍dvāgͫsa̠ścaina̍ścakṛ̠ma tasyā̍ va̠yaja̍namasi̠ svāhā̎|
yadvo̍ devāścakṛ̠ma ji̠hvayā̍ gu̠rumana̍so vā̠ prayu̍tī deva̠ heḍa̍nam|
arā̍vā̠yo no̍ a̠bhidu̍cchunā̠yate̠ tasmi̠n tadeno̍ vasavo̠ nidhe̍tana̠ svāhā̎
kāmo'kārṣīt kāmaḥ karoti nāhaṃ karomi kāmaḥ karttā nāhaṃ karttā kāmaḥ̍ kāra̠yitā nāhaṃ̍ kāra̠yitā eṣa te kāma kāmā̍ya svā̠hā
manyurakārṣīn manyuḥ karoti nāhaṃ karomi manyuḥ karttā nāhaṃ karttā manyuḥ̍ kāra̠yitā nāhaṃ̍ kāra̠yitā eṣa te manyo manya̍ve svā̠hā
tilāñjuhomi sarasāgͫ sapiṣṭān gandhāra mama citte rama̍ntu svā̠hā||
gāvo hiraṇyaṃ dhanamannapānagͫ sarveṣāgͫͫ śri̍yai svā̠hā||
śriyañca lakhṣmiñca puṣṭiñca kīrttiṃ̍ cā nṛ̠ṇyatām|
tilāḥ punantu̍ me pā̠pa̠ym̐yatkiñcid duritaṃ ma̍yi svā̠hā||
gosteyagͫ sa̍rāpā̠naṃ̠ bhrūṇahatyā tilā śāntigͫ śamaya̍ntu svā̠hā||
śrīśca lakhṣmīśca puṣṭīśca kīrttiṃ̍ cā nṛ̠ṇyatām|
prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
vāṅmanaścakhṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaretobuddhyākūtiḥ saṅkalpā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
tvakcarmamāgͫsarudhiramedomajjāsnāyavo'sthīni me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
śiraḥ pāṇi pāda pārśva pṛṣṭhorūdarajaṅghaśiśñopastha pāyavo me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
uttiṣṭha puruṣa haritapiṅgala lohitākhṣi dehi dehi dadāpayitā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎
pṛthivyāpa stejo vāyurākāśā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
śabdasparśarūparasagandhā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
manovākkāyakarmāṇi me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
avyaktabhāvaira̍haṅkā̠ra̠r jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
ātmā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
antarātmā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
paramātmā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠haṃ vi̠ram̐jā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎||
abhū̍ti̠masa̍mṛddhi̠ñca̠ sarvāṃ (sarvā) nirṇuda me pāpmā̍nagͫͫ svā̠hā||
annamayaprāṇamayamanomayavijñānamayamānandamayamātmā me̍ śuddhya̠ntāṃ̠ jyoti̍ ra̠havm̐vi̠rajā̍ vipā̠pmā bhū̍yāsa̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̎
yadeja̍ti̠ jaga̍ti̠ yacca̠ ceṣṭa̍ti̠ nāmno̍ bhā̠go'yaṃ nāmne̠ svāhā̎|
namo̍ ru̠drāya̍ paśu̠pata̍ye̠ svāhā̎ de̠vebhyaḥ̠ svāhā̎|
ye bhū̠tāḥ pra̠cara̍nti̠ divā̠naktaṃ̠ bali̍mi̠cchanto̍ vi̠tuda̍sya̠ preṣyāḥ̎|
tebhyo̍ ba̠liṃ pu̍ṣṭi̠kāmo̍ harāmi̠ mayi̠ puṣṭiṃ̠ puṣṭi̍patir dadhātu̠ svāhā̎
tvaṃ ta̍dāpa̠ āpo̠ jyotī̠ raso̠'mṛtaṃ̠ brahma̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuva̠roṃ
